isMainInventoryEmpty() && isAdditionalInventoryEmpty(); asked by the server tick every tick

corpse_idle_scan_streamless.conversion: @Inject HEAD (cancellable) of CorpseEntity.isMainInventoryEmpty and isAdditionalInventoryEmpty: plain loops over the same lists, same order, same ItemStack.isEmpty calls, same short-circuit (CorpseScans). Runtime flag corpseIdleScanStreamless.

guard.note: maxDeathAge < 0 -> return; age = days * 86,400,000 ms; new Thread(() -> removeDeathsOlderThan(level, age)).start()
the thread's whole task: DeathManager.removeDeathsOlderThan(level, age)
takes now when it runs; deletes every death file older than age (lastModified and the death's time stamp): a later sweep deletes a superset

corpse_death_sweep_single_worker.conversion: @Inject before the NEW Thread of DeathEvents.deleteOldDeaths (cancellable, locals captured: days, age): the sweep goes to one shared worker thread (ThreadPoolExecutor 0..1 threads, keep-alive 0, threads made by new Thread(task)); a request is dropped while a sweep of the same server and age is queued and not started. Fix: sweeps never overlap (no race, no FileNotFoundException traces, no thread per death); same files deleted, same INFO lines. Runtime flag corpseDeathSweepSingleWorker. Helper bons.furious.patch.corpse_coo49.CorpseSweeps.
corpse_death_sweep_single_worker.license: Corpse (All Rights Reserved): no code carried; the hook calls Corpse's own DeathManager.removeDeathsOlderThan

guard.note: every player death asks for one sweep of the old death files

corpse_death_sweep_interval.conversion: @Inject HEAD (cancellable) of DeathEvents.deleteOldDeaths: a request within N seconds (the value, default 300) of the last accepted request of the same server is dropped; requests with maxDeathAge < 0 are never counted. Trade-off, off by default: expired death files can stay on disk until the first death after the interval. Value: PureConfig.intValue("corpse_death_sweep_interval", 300, 1, 86400). Runtime flag corpseDeathSweepInterval. Helper bons.furious.patch.corpse_coo49.CorpseSweeps.
corpse_death_sweep_interval.license: Corpse (All Rights Reserved): no code carried; the hook only decides whether Corpse's sweep is requested
